title: Product of all others
prompt:
Write `ProductExceptSelf(in []int) []int` where `out[i]` is the product of every element except `in[i]`. Don't use division: it breaks on zeros.

`[1 2 3]` → `[6 3 2]`, `[2 0 4]` → `[0 8 0]`. An empty slice gives an empty slice.
hint: `out[i]` is the prefix product before `i` times the suffix product after it: two passes.
